capabilities.finding: Timestamped extraction exists; default static 1 FPS can miss fast action. Current pipeline samples only first 480 seconds at low resolution.
capabilities.benchmark: Compare timestamped movement/teaching extraction with practitioner labels; include fast footwork, occlusion and mirrored views.

capabilities.finding: Browser-capable pose landmarks exist; posture estimation does not validate dance correctness or weight transfer.
capabilities.benchmark: Measure visible errors, false corrections and abstention across bodies, clothes, lighting and camera angles.

capabilities.finding: Bidirectional live audio/video is documented; documented 1 FPS video is not high-speed motion validation.
capabilities.benchmark: Commands over music, interruption, stop/pause, response latency and privacy; separate semantic interaction from motion scoring.

capabilities.finding: Media timing and jitter statistics can be measured; no Dance Atlas synchronization benchmark exists.
capabilities.benchmark: Measure end-to-end timing, beat-phase drift, jitter, late joins and recovery; use local shared beat and turn-taking if needed.

capabilities.finding: WebXR defines access to AR/VR devices; it is not an implemented Dance Atlas experience.
capabilities.benchmark: Device support, calibration, safe boundaries, comfort, accessible fallback and network cost.

capabilities.finding: Music Library use needs express written authorization under section 4.2, subject to stated exceptions. Commercial generation rights alone do not settle the proposed product.
capabilities.benchmark: Written use-scope decision plus quality, originality, territories, exports and per-session economics.
